parts.label: robot head
parts.appearance: rounded rectangular head shell with a broad gently convex front face panel and circular inset side disks, centered above a short neck

parts.label: neck column
parts.appearance: short vertically stacked cylindrical column with a wide lower ring, connecting the underside of the head to the top center of the torso

parts.label: chest torso
parts.appearance: broad rounded trapezoidal shell with sloping shoulders, a gently convex chest and a narrowed lower edge, centered in the upper body

parts.label: waist connector
parts.appearance: short tapered stacked polygonal column with an angular front plate, connecting the narrow torso base to the pelvis

parts.label: pelvis shell
parts.appearance: compact rounded basin-shaped shell with a wide upper rim, curved front and two lateral circular hip sockets

parts.label: left shoulder hub
parts.appearance: rounded spherical joint enclosed by a curved outer cap, projecting laterally from the left upper corner of the torso

parts.label: left upper arm
parts.appearance: elongated gently tapered shell with a rounded rectangular cross section, angling slightly outward and downward from the left shoulder to the elbow

parts.label: left elbow hub
parts.appearance: short thick cylindrical joint with broad round side caps, placed horizontally between the left upper arm and forearm

parts.label: left forearm
parts.appearance: long tapered curved shell widening near the elbow and narrowing at the wrist, descending slightly outward along the left lower arm

parts.label: left hand
parts.appearance: compact hand with a rounded rectangular palm, four short segmented curled fingers and one opposed thumb, hanging below the left wrist

parts.label: left thigh
parts.appearance: long slightly tapered rounded shell with a broad upper circular hip attachment and narrowed lower knee opening, descending from the left side of the pelvis

parts.label: left knee hub
parts.appearance: large round cylindrical joint with domed side caps, connecting the left thigh to the shin at mid leg height

parts.label: left lower leg
parts.appearance: long smoothly tapered shell with a convex front and a narrowed ankle opening, descending vertically below the left knee

parts.label: left foot
parts.appearance: broad low rounded rectangular foot projecting forward with a thick flat sole and a raised cylindrical ankle at the rear
